title: Content
subtitle: Views, engagement, clicks and generated leads from your connected networks.
youtubeEarlySignals: I’m checking the first signals now. Publish a few more videos so I can see which patterns hold.
youtubeIdeas: I found {count} idea(s) based on what already works on your channel.
youtubeEnoughData: There is enough YouTube data to suggest new ideas. Generate them with Creator Falco.
overviewConnected: Your connected networks have {views} total views across {posts} post(s).
overviewDisconnected: Connect a social network to see your content performance.
instagramNotProfessional: This Instagram account is personal. Switch it to Business or Creator and try again.
instagramError: Instagram connection failed. Try again in a moment.
youtubeNoChannel: No YouTube channel is associated with this Google account. Sign in with the account that owns the channel.
youtubeNoRefreshToken: Google did not return permanent access. Try connecting again, then reconnect Minaly if needed.
youtubeError: YouTube connection failed. Try again in a moment.
youtubeState: I’m checking the signals from your YouTube channel.
formatHelp: YouTube Analytics provides the content type used for each view. New syncs use that field to separate Shorts from long videos. Older rows without it stay unclassified until the next sync.
instagramCtrHelp: Instagram provides no outbound click data for an organic post. This metric is empty by design.
instagramLeadsHelp: A post needs to be linked manually to attribute a lead. This metric stays at 0 for now.
youtubeRetentionHelp: Average share of each video watched by viewers for the selected period and format. YouTube uses this signal when it recommends videos.

youtube.topVideosHelp: Videos ranked by views since you connected YouTube.
youtube.topVideosSub: Ranked by views and {format} since connection.
youtube.noVideosHelp: Connect your YouTube channel above to see your videos.
youtube.noPeriodHelp: Choose All to see the full history.
youtube.title: Title
youtube.hooksTitle: What gets people to click and watch
youtube.enoughData: Based on {count} video{plural} with enough data
youtube.retentionHelp: Analysis starts after a video reaches {views} views. We fetch curves for your most-viewed videos at each sync.
youtube.medianDropOffHelp: The point where half your audience has left, measured on each video's retention curve. We use the median so one video that drops at 5 seconds does not skew the result.
youtube.below30: Under 30 s: the hook is losing viewers, not the rest of the video.
youtube.afterHook: After the hook: check where the pace drops.
youtube.retention30Help: Share of viewers still watching after 30 seconds. This is where the hook plays out. Videos shorter than 30 seconds are excluded.
youtube.retentionAtHelp: Share of viewers still watching at {seconds} seconds. The measure follows the format: 30 seconds for long videos and 3 seconds for Shorts.
youtube.importedAverage: Average from {count} video{plural} without a detailed curve
youtube.importedRetentionNote: Imported average retention: {value}. Detailed curves are not available for this format yet.
youtube.noTrafficData: No traffic source data for this format yet
youtube.trafficDataHelp: Refresh YouTube to fetch the channel-level report.
youtube.hookGap: {value} retention gap at {seconds} s between the two. See how you open "{title}" and use the same structure.
youtube.trafficHelp: Official YouTube Analytics traffic categories. The bars use the full channel history and add up to 100%.
youtube.legacyTrafficScope: Detailed video data across {count} video{plural}. Refresh YouTube to cover the full channel.
youtube.searchTerms: What people search to find you
youtube.searchHelp: Top YouTube search queries from the full channel history. The list refreshes with each YouTube sync.
youtube.channelSearchScope: All formats, full channel history, fetched {date}.
youtube.legacySearchScope: Detailed video data across {count} video{plural}. Refresh YouTube to cover the full channel.
youtube.searchDataHelp: Search terms appear after the next successful YouTube sync.
youtube.importedHelp: Average share watched, retrieved from YouTube for videos with more than 100 views.
youtube.importedReady: Your videos are analyzed. We fetch detailed curves at the next YouTube refresh. The figures above are ready for format comparisons.

explanations.retention: Average share of the video watched. YouTube uses it with watch time when deciding whether to recommend a video. Color compares this video with the median of your other videos in the same format.
explanations.watchTime: Total watch time accumulated on this video, in minutes.
explanations.duration: The actual length of the video, as reported by YouTube.
explanations.subscribers: Subscribers gained minus subscribers lost, generated directly by this video and reported by YouTube.
explanations.bookings: Booked calls attributed to this video. Enter them manually because YouTube does not expose this data.
explanations.dealsClosed: Calls from this video that resulted in a sale. Enter them manually.

table.topPostsHelp: Ranking of your posts, reels, and carousels by total interactions since connecting your Instagram account.
table.topPostsSubtitle: Ranked by interactions across all posts since connection.
table.noPostsHelp: Connect your Instagram account above to see your posts.
table.noPostsPeriodHelp: Choose All to see the full history.
table.title: Title
table.followersHelp: New followers generated by this post. Instagram does not return this metric for every format. An em dash means the value is unavailable, not zero.

detail.instagramNotice: Outbound clicks on an organic post cannot be measured through the Instagram API, so they do not appear here.
detail.youtubeNotice: YouTube does not expose booking data. Enter it here for this video.

recommendations.title: Your next videos
recommendations.subtitle: Here is what to film this week based on your current performance.
recommendations.notEnoughTitle: Publish a few more videos so I can find patterns that hold.
recommendations.notEnoughHelp: Creator Falco needs at least {count} analyzable public videos to suggest ideas.
recommendations.emptyTitle: Your next ideas are being prepared.
recommendations.emptyHelp: Regenerate ideas when your YouTube data is up to date.
recommendations.firstGenerationTitle: Generate your first set of ideas.
recommendations.firstGenerationHelp: Falco will use your analyzable public videos to suggest topics grounded in what already works on your channel.
recommendations.impactMethod: Impact uses the median views of your source videos with a cautious range. It is a planning signal, not a promise.
recommendations.impactBasisFallback: A cautious estimate based on your source videos' performance. It is not a promise.

youtubeAnalytics.topVideosHelp: The three videos with the most views in the selected format.
youtubeAnalytics.noVideosHelp: Connect your YouTube channel and wait for the first sync.
youtubeAnalytics.noPeriodHelp: Choose All to see the full history.
youtubeAnalytics.tableSubtitle: See what works and what needs attention at a glance. Statuses use your usual baseline.
youtubeAnalytics.columnsHelp: The first metrics stay visible. Choose the metrics you want to add.
youtubeAnalytics.columnsMemoryNote: Your column choices are saved on this device.
youtubeAnalytics.diagnosisHelp: Each row gives one conclusion. Open the details to see the signals behind it.
youtubeAnalytics.retentionHelp: Retention shows both the share of viewers still watching at 30 seconds and the average share watched.
youtubeAnalytics.diffusionHelp: Reach shows whether YouTube is putting the video in front of viewers. Impressions count thumbnail exposures.
youtubeAnalytics.clickHelp: CTR is the share of people who clicked after seeing the title and thumbnail.
youtubeAnalytics.growthHelp: Growth shows how many subscribers the video brings for every 1,000 views. The raw count is secondary.
youtubeAnalytics.businessHelp: Bookings and revenue come from Minaly's commercial tracking. A missing value means it has not been tracked.
youtubeAnalytics.comparisonDetail: {delta}% compared with your {count} earlier long videos
youtubeAnalytics.diagnosisSummary: The cards show how this video compares with your earlier long videos. A low sample stays neutral until the signal is large enough.
youtubeAnalytics.funnelHelp: The path from thumbnail exposure to watch time. Impressions and CTR come from YouTube's daily bulk reports when available.
youtubeAnalytics.reachSyncPending: Reach data is waiting to sync
youtubeAnalytics.reachSyncHelp: YouTube sends thumbnail impressions and CTR in a daily report. The first report can take up to 72 hours to arrive.
youtubeAnalytics.reachPendingHelp: Minaly has scheduled the YouTube reach report. Impressions and CTR will appear when YouTube publishes it.
youtubeAnalytics.reachHistoricalHelp: YouTube only provides this data from the time Minaly starts tracking, with about 30 days of initial history.
youtubeAnalytics.reachSyncErrorHelp: This video is within the tracked history window, but the latest YouTube report did not include its reach data. Check the next sync.
youtubeAnalytics.reachMetricUnavailableHelp: The report is available, but YouTube did not return this metric for this video.
youtubeAnalytics.velocityImpressionsUnavailable: Impressions at day 1, day 2 and day 7 will appear after YouTube reports are imported.
youtubeAnalytics.retentionChartHelp: The curve shows the share of viewers still watching at each point in the video.
youtubeAnalytics.trafficHelp: YouTube's traffic source categories for this video.
youtubeAnalytics.noTrafficData: Traffic source data is not available yet.
youtubeAnalytics.velocityHelp: Cumulative views captured around the first days after publishing.
youtubeAnalytics.velocityNotOldEnough: This video is not seven days old yet. We will compare it after the next snapshots.
youtubeAnalytics.velocityNoSnapshot: Daily snapshots are not available yet.
youtubeAnalytics.bingeUnavailable: End-screen and card reports are not available yet. YouTube generates these reports after the reporting jobs are active.
youtubeAnalytics.revenueUnavailable: Revenue stays hidden until Minaly has enough declared attributions to make the figure useful.
youtubeAnalytics.editCommercialTracking: Edit commercial numbers in the video table.
youtubeAnalytics.diagnosisLowReachStrongRetention: Retention is strong, but reach is still low.
youtubeAnalytics.diagnosisStrongReachWeakRetention: Reach is strong, but viewers leave too early.
youtubeAnalytics.diagnosisRetentionWeak: Retention is the main signal to improve.
youtubeAnalytics.diagnosisBusinessStrong: This video is already producing a strong business signal.
